statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); branch=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$(basename "$dir")"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf ' on \033[35m%s\033[0m' "$branch"; printf ' via \033[33m%s\033[0m' "$model"; [ -n "$pct" ] && printf ' \033[32m%.0f%% ctx\033[0m' "$pct"; echo
